title: Verify: Zero-quota inline message unit tests
summary: Unit tests for the quota message
description: Write unit tests from REQ1 using mocked listMine and submitContribution.

steps.action: Create the test file with the vi.mock setup copied from contributionMaxLength.test.tsx, mocking listMine and submitContribution. Add test 'shows the quota message at zero remaining': listMineMock resolves 5 copies of contributionFixture with distinct prompt values, render the sheet, await screen.findByText('You have used all your suggestions this round') and assert it. Add test 'hides the message with quota left': listMineMock resolves [contributionFixture], render, wait for the 'Sent' label, assert queryByText of the message is null. Import contributionFixture from tests/fixtures/api.ts, which mirrors the Contribution type in src/api/client.ts.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionQuota.test.tsx -t "quota message"
